public_history: Ari buys one tool hour before wet queues grow.
Ari buys food before repair fatigue raises hunger.
Ari rations heat wood instead of buying at the cold spike.
Ari repays a social help obligation with a dry-route repair check.
Ari buys a thaw-repair tool hour despite tool bottleneck pricing.
Ari repays food support through a ration transfer, lowering obligation pressure.
Ari buys harvest food while price is low and hunger can recover.
Ari refuses another cheap tool hour because rest need beats price temptation.
Fay gives Ari a care token to keep the repair visit reciprocal.
Fay buys cloth while wet-season price is still moderate.
Fay pays cold-scarcity heat price to protect the stove ritual.
Fay gifts food to Milo after seeing debt pressure.
Fay refuses extra heat wood and accepts a colder evening blanket posture.
Fay buys herbs for a repair visit while food pressure is lower.
Fay buys cheap harvest heat wood for future ritual security.
Fay spends social energy hosting a shared repair meal.
Milo buys lamp oil for quiet archive work.
Milo refuses vellum because archive expansion can wait.
Milo borrows food at cold-scarcity price, raising debt burden.
Milo cannot buy the tool hour and archive expansion stalls.
Milo buys one vellum sheet even at thaw repair pricing because the archive is blocked.
Milo partially repays cold-season food debt with a care token, not full food value.
Milo buys cheaper harvest tool access and unblocks the archive review.
Milo ends the season fed but still carrying a small cold-food debt memory.

claim_boundary: Deterministic needs marketplace and seasonal price-pressure substrate only: not real markets, not real labor, not real consent, not subjective consciousness, and not moral patienthood.
